name: d3vices.com
description: Open-source browser hardware diagnostics. Test your mic, camera, screen, keyboard, sensors and inputs — in the browser, as an installable PWA, or as a native desktop app.

scripts.dev: bun run build:client && bun run --hot apps/web/src/main.js
scripts.desktop: bun run build:site && cd apps/desktop && bun run start
scripts.desktop:dist: bun run build:site && cd apps/desktop && bun run dist
